pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If Step 031's Identifiable(g,Omega) definition were shown to concern a materially different Omega than the ones a's audit catalogued (e.g. a private notational device never actually used as one of the >=4 corpus-wide senses), the refinement claim would be weaker; a's own S2910 cross-reference argues against this.

pairs_touching.what_says_this: a is an explicit catalogue of >=4 overloaded senses of the symbol Omega. pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: Would be wrong if e-v-omega-symbol-overload's catalogue of senses does not in fact include the Omega_D/Omega_E domain/epistemic split, making the overlap purely symbolic (same letter, unrelated senses).
